description: Production delivery advisor for Codex with conditional React, TypeScript, Postgres, and worker specialist profiles.

interface.shortDescription: Apply Fast-only Luna production delivery with conditional domain profiles, escalate safely, and verify before acceptance.
interface.longDescription: Sol Development Advisor is a production delivery advisor for Codex. GPT-5.6 Sol stays in the primary session for architecture, decomposition, verification, and acceptance. Every implementation stream carries production-delivery, with React, TypeScript backend, Postgres/data, and worker/integration profiles selected only when owned paths and acceptance require them. The default economy policy routes bounded green work through user-visible GPT-5.6 Luna / Max / Fast app tasks, failing closed when the Fast service tier cannot be explicitly set and observed. Monitoring is capability-adaptive: wait_threads is preferred, while bounded exact-thread read_thread polling is supported when the proven baseline operations are exposed. Balanced policy escalates amber and red work to a separately installed GPT-5.6 Terra / High native role when appropriate, while critical policy always requires a fresh Sol review after parent verification. Optional Linear intake is read-only and never a hard dependency.
defaultPrompt: For bounded economy implementation work, apply production-delivery and route to Luna / Max / Fast when eligible; fail closed if Fast cannot be set and observed.
For critical implementation work, keep architecture in Sol, route implementation through Terra / High, then require a fresh Sol review.
